'''Namadii''' was an astronomical object<ref name="AoRCR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> located in the [[Namadii system/Legends|Namadii system]], a part of the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]], which connected it to the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Namadii was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Namadii lay in the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> and during the first campaigns of that conflict, the Republic's [[Seventh Army|Seventh Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Namadii's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" />

The celestial body was situated in territory under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Namadii [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered from 1 million to 10 million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Namadii was introduced via map label in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square I-6.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[2014]], Namadii was established as a distinct astronomical object by the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="AoRCR" />
